title: Consciousness is not where integration is greatest

statements.text: Unlike IIT, the theory does not predict that computational information integration is exclusive to or maximal in consciousness. Heavily integrated tasks such as running over rough ground can be done without awareness, while simple inputs such as a stubbed toe take over conscious thought.

sources.quote: the theory does not predict that, as understood in its usual temporal or computational sense, information integration is either exclusive to, or maximal in, consciousness
